# Sidemorphic

> A side panel for Chrome. Pin any website to the edge of the browser and read
> it beside the page you are on, with search, a scratchpad and snippets in the
> same panel. Everything is stored as ordinary bookmarks, so it follows you
> between machines with no account and no server.

Free and open source, made by Lightmorphic. Works in Chrome 114 or newer and
the Chromium browsers that install Web Store extensions: Edge, Brave, Vivaldi
and Opera. There is no Firefox version, because Firefox has no equivalent side
panel API.

## What it does

- Pinned panels: any site opens in the panel beside the page you are reading.
- Search: seven engines, results open in the panel, and it does not touch your
  new tab page.
- Scratchpad: a notepad that is always one click away.
- Snippets: saved text that goes into the box you are typing in when clicked.

## What it does not do

- No account, no sign-in, no server of ours, no analytics, no tracking.
- No access to any website when installed. It asks for one site at a time, at
  the moment you first open that site in the panel.
- No new tab page takeover and no other changes to the browser.

## Where data lives

In one bookmarks folder called Sidemorphic, in Other Bookmarks. Because that is
bookmarks, the browser's own bookmark sync carries it between machines. Nothing
is transmitted to Lightmorphic. Deleting the folder deletes the data.
